name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-campaign-story
title: Campaign Story
shortDescription: Creates a self-contained animated HTML campaign story for a product, customer case, launch, or operational transformation, with narrated scenes and playback controls.
longDescription: Turns a source brief or SharePoint file into a one-minute campaign story with a tight 5–6 scene arc: pain point, three improvement moments, a measurable outcome, and a payoff with CTA.

Outputs a single self-contained HTML file in the NexusFlow premium B2B application design. The file includes scene progress, motion-driven action cards, checkmarks, a count-up result scene, and a confetti finale, with no external images, fonts, or libraries.

Narration uses the viewer’s installed browser voices. Playback includes play/pause, previous, next, restart, narration toggle, voice picker, and speed. If a real source is supplied, the skill does not invent names, quotes, or metrics.
